title: 我要打包银河系的爱给你
concept: ONE blank envelope tied like a tiny gift package, with one glossy galaxy-heart orb emerging from it.
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art candidate for achievement_medal_postcards_tier_008, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd but simple premium collectible postcard achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "我要打包银河系的爱给你". The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and glossy saturated enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE blank envelope tied like a tiny gift package, with one glossy galaxy-heart orb emerging from it. Keep the blank postcard or envelope as the dominant readable shape; use at most one secondary object.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, deliberately silly but premium, raised metal relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: ultra-simple large silhouette, card/envelope centered and dominant, key gag readable at 58pt UI size. Cosmic effect can glow, but keep the orb as one object.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, tiny star glints as lighting only, awkwardly sincere over-the-top affection comedy.
Color palette: glossy ivory card, saturated metallic gold rim, warm teal or jewel-tone enamel, one vivid accent color for the secondary object, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, smooth blank postcard surface, beveled rim. No dominant paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no suitcase, no shoes, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
